# 성시원 제조 AI 아카이브 (sianism manufacturing-AI archive)

> A personal manufacturing-AI knowledge archive run by an individual, 성시원 (sianism). Not a company site or a news outlet. Each post is kept here in Korean and English. Author: 성시원 (sianism), 책임연구원 in service planning at INTERX (인터엑스), a manufacturing AI company. Posts are personal summaries based on public sources, not official company positions.

Each post exists in Korean (ko) and English (en); the Korean page is the original.

## Posts

- [용접 품질 AI는 무엇을 보고 판단할까? 전류·전압·소리·빛·영상 데이터별 정리 (비교표 + FAQ 6문항)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/welding-quality-ai-data/) (2026-11-13, 한국어): 용접 품질 AI가 쓰는 데이터 5가지(전류·전압, 음향, 광 신호, 카메라, NDT 이미지) 비교표와 FAQ 6문항. Madhvacharyula 외 2022(Welding in the World), Lee 외 2024(대한용접·접합학회지), ISO 5817·KS B ISO 5817 기준.
- [What Does Welding Quality AI Actually Look At? Current, Voltage, Sound, Light, and Cameras Explained](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/welding-quality-ai-data/) (2026-11-13, English): What weld quality AI reads: current and voltage, acoustic, optical, camera, and NDT image data, with typical models (LSTM, CNN on STFT/wavelet images), explainability (SHAP, Grad-CAM), and ISO 5817 quality levels for labels, based on Madhvacharyula 2022 and Lee 2024.
- [AI 비전 검사 솔루션, 무엇을 기준으로 고를까? 지표·검증·현장 조건 7가지 기준 (비교표 템플릿 + FAQ 6문항)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/ai-vision-inspection-criteria/) (2026-11-10, 한국어): AI 비전 검사 솔루션 선정 기준 7가지(불량 정의·미검/과검 지표·검증 방식·데이터 부담·속도·변화 대응·운영) 비교표 템플릿과 FAQ 6문항. Hütten 외 2024 서베이, Carvalho 외 2023 벤치마크, Liu 외 2023 이상 탐지, 중기부 2024 실태조사.
- [How to Choose an AI Visual Inspection System for Manufacturing: 7 Criteria That Matter More Than "99% Accuracy"](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/ai-vision-inspection-criteria/) (2026-11-10, English): Seven criteria for choosing an AI visual inspection system: defect definitions, miss/false-reject rates, held-out line validation, data burden, takt time, change handling, and explainable operations, with research from Hütten 2024, Carvalho 2023, Liu 2023, and Korea MSS 2024 survey.
- [제조 디지털 트윈 도입 체크리스트 10가지: 무엇부터 준비할까 (국제 표준 ISO 23247 기준 + FAQ 6문항)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/manufacturing-digital-twin-checklist/) (2026-11-06, 한국어): 제조 디지털 트윈 도입 전 체크리스트 10가지(목적·대상·충실도·데이터·동기화·제어·식별자·연동·보안·검증)와 FAQ 6문항. ISO 23247·ISO/IEC 30173·NIST AMS 400-2·IR 8356·IEC 63278-1, 과기정통부·산업부 정책 맥락.
- [A 10-Point Checklist Before You Build a Manufacturing Digital Twin (Based on ISO 23247 and NIST Guidance)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/manufacturing-digital-twin-checklist/) (2026-11-06, English): Ten planning checks before building a manufacturing digital twin: purpose, target, fidelity, data collection, synchronization, control, identifiers, MES/ERP integration, security (NIST IR 8356), and verification, grounded in ISO 23247, ISO/IEC 30173, and NIST AMS 400-2.
- [사출성형 불량, AI는 어떻게 원인을 찾을까? 공정 데이터·센서·비전 3가지 접근 정리 (비교표 + FAQ 6문항)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/injection-molding-defect-ai/) (2026-11-03, 한국어): 사출 불량 원인 분석에 쓰이는 AI 접근 3가지(공정 조건→품질 예측, 센서 시계열 이상 탐지, 비전 검사) 비교표와 FAQ 6문항(XAI 원인 판단 비교 연구, 금형 내 압력·쿠션량, 플래시 불량 분할, 뿌리기술 '사출·프레스', 산업부 산업 AI 10대 과제).
- [How AI Finds the Root Cause of Injection Molding Defects: Three Data Approaches and One Warning](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/injection-molding-defect-ai/) (2026-11-03, English): How AI approaches injection molding defect root cause analysis: process-to-quality models with explainable AI (SHAP vs ICE), anomaly detection on cavity pressure and melt cushion, vision inspection of flash defects, and Korea's root-technology and industrial AI policy context.
- [제조 특화 LLM이란? 범용 LLM과 무엇이 다른가 (비교표 + FAQ, 국내 공공 사례)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/manufacturing-llm-vs-general-llm/) (2026-10-30, 한국어): 제조 특화 LLM과 범용 LLM·제조 파운데이션 모델(MFM)의 차이 비교표와 FAQ 6문항(RAG, 도메인 적응 학습, 산업부 AI 팩토리·KETI MFM 과제, NIST AI 600-1 환각 위험).
- [What Is a Manufacturing-Specific LLM? How It Differs from a General-Purpose LLM (and What Korea Is Building)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/manufacturing-llm-vs-general-llm/) (2026-10-30, English): How a manufacturing-specific LLM differs from a general-purpose LLM and from a manufacturing foundation model (MFM): RAG, domain-adaptive pretraining, hallucination risk (NIST AI 600-1), and Korea's AI Factory and KETI MFM projects.
- [중소 제조기업 AI 도입, 무엇부터 준비하나? 미리 챙길 데이터 5가지 (체크리스트 + FAQ)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/ai-data-readiness-small-manufacturers/) (2026-10-23, 한국어): 중소 제조기업이 AI 도입 전에 준비할 데이터 5가지 체크리스트와 데이터 품질(ISO/IEC 25012)·KAMP 데이터셋·정부 지원 FAQ 6문항.
- [Before AI, Get Your Data Ready: 5 Datasets Small Manufacturers Should Prepare (with Korea's Policy Context)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/ai-data-readiness-small-manufacturers/) (2026-10-23, English): Five kinds of data a small manufacturer should prepare before AI, with Korea's 2025 smart manufacturing survey, ISO/IEC 25012 and KAMP datasets.
- [AI 자율제조 vs 스마트팩토리 vs MES, 뭐가 다를까? (자주 묻는 질문 정리)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/ai-autonomous-manufacturing-vs-smart-factory-vs-mes/) (2026-10-21, 한국어): MES·스마트팩토리·AI 자율제조의 차이를 비교표와 FAQ 6문항으로 정리(산업부 AI 자율제조 전략 1.0, ISA-95, 스마트공장 수준).
- [AI Autonomous Manufacturing vs Smart Factory vs MES: an FAQ (with Korea's policy context)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/ai-autonomous-manufacturing-vs-smart-factory-vs-mes/) (2026-10-21, English): How MES, smart factory and AI autonomous manufacturing differ, with a comparison table, FAQ and Korea's AI Autonomous Manufacturing policy context.
